Confirmed: only my new test file references the new module. The full suite's failures are all in DB/RBAC/permission-schema tests that depend on the shared `pg_pool` test-DB fixture — none related to `util_text`/`slugify_title`. Per the repo guidance, these are pre-existing and left untouched.

## Report

### What changed (2 new files, no existing files modified)

**`src/mem_mcp/util_text.py`** — new module exposing `slugify_title(title: str) -> str`:
1. Trims surrounding whitespace + lowercases (`str.lower()` first, so uppercased ASCII is preserved while it may emit non-ASCII like `É`→`é`).
2. Replaces every run of non-`[a-z0-9]` characters with a single `-` via a module-level precompiled regex `_NON_ALNUM_RUN = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")`.
3. Strips leading/trailing hyphens.

Non-ASCII letters are intentionally dropped/turned into separators (no transliteration, no new dependency), mirroring the existing `slugs` table constraint. Module docstring explains the ASCII-only *why*; function has a short docstring. `from __future__ import annotations`, full type hints, `~100`-col formatted.

**`tests/unit/test_util_text.py`** — pure unit tests (no DB), `pytest.mark.parametrize`, covering: normal text (`"Hello World"`→`"hello-world"`); punctuation/whitespace run collapse + edge stripping (`"  Foo -- Bar!!! baz  "`→`"foo-bar-baz"`, `"a---b"`→`"a-b"`, `"---abc---"`→`"abc"`); empty/whitespace/punctuation-only → `""`; non-ASCII (`"Café Crème"`→`"caf-cr-me"`, `"日本語"`→`""`); digits preserved; idempotency on already-slugified input and across repeated calls.

### Verification

- **`pytest tests/unit/test_util_text.py -q`** → `19 passed in 0.09s` (all new tests green)
- **`ruff check src tests`** → `All checks passed!`
- **`ruff format --check src/mem_mcp/util_text.py tests/unit/test_util_text.py`** → `2 files already formatted`
- **`mypy`** → `Success: no issues found in 333 source files` (no errors in the new files)
- **`pytest -q`** (full suite) → `18 failed, 1366 passed, 31 skipped, 94 warnings, 16 errors`
  - All 19 new tests passed.
  - Git status confirms the change is purely additive (only two untracked files; no existing source/fixture/conftest touched), and grep confirms none of the failing/erroring tests reference `util_text`/`slugify_title`.
  - The failures/errors are confined to DB- and RBAC/permission-schema tests that depend on the shared `pg_pool` test-container fixture (e.g. `test_effective_access_recompute`, `test_refresh_team_access`, `test_rbac_resolver`, `test_roles_catalog`, `test_enterprise_schema`, `test_slugs_schema::test_pk_uniqueness_within_scope`, `test_team_api`, `test_enterprise_mcp_tools`, `test_security/test_scope_enforcement`, `test_team_role_assignments_schema`, `test_user_effective_team_access_schema`, `test_spec2_slug_lookup`). These are the pre-existing fixture failures called out in the environment notes; I left them untouched per the rules.

Nothing is left open for this work order.
